blurb: Guests take boat tours including dolphin watching, fishing, pirate ship cruises, sunset and fireworks cruises, and private charters. Cruises stay close to shore in Laguna Madre except offshore fishing charters which go 5 to 20 miles into the Gulf. Boats have enclosed or shaded areas, restrooms, and some offer food and drink for purchase.
